svg.title: Room 3 at ten past nine, from the front
svg.desc: A classroom seen from the front with eleven desks, a board still carrying yesterday's lesson, and an open cupboard holding a single shelf with one dictionary, a box of pens and four notebooks.

g.text: Room 3 at ten past nine, from the front
Fourteen things to find. One of them has not moved since Tuesday.
the top of the board - yesterday, not wiped
the window - and a plant that belongs to nobody
the back wall - the clock, and the door
Teresa - at the board, teaching at ten
Lin - she looked a word up on Tuesday
Yusuf - a notebook, and no pen
Emre - the dictionary is on his desk, face down
the box of pens - one box, eleven people
Ana - counting what is in the cupboard
